payload.summary: Planned Phase A of the documentation-simplification proposal: a three-layer doc structure (README/VISION entry points, one-concept-per-guide docs/guides, generated or formal reference), a tagged lessons corpus, retirement of the hand-maintained skills catalogue, and document metadata pinned by one new test module. Gate 1 selected the hand-authored approach over a producer-backed restructure; tier is coordinated with five packages, three in parallel.

decisions.title: Three-layer documentation with a single map
decisions.rationale: Layer 0 entry points, Layer 1 one-concept guides under docs/guides/, Layer 2 generated or formal reference; docs/guides/documentation.md is the only index. Completes harness-engineering Progressive Context Architecture on the human-reader side.

decisions.title: Generated inventory replaces the hand-maintained skills catalogue
decisions.rationale: docs/skills-catalogue.md is deleted; its orientation prose moves outside the producer's markers in skills-inventory.md, which the producer preserves byte-for-byte. No spec named the catalogue, so no delta beyond the new requirement.

decisions.title: Lessons carry status and evidence tags and are retired by moving, never deleted silently
decisions.rationale: Turns the append-only Documentation Update Per Iteration rule into a maintained corpus the Phase B /simplify-docs skill can re-verify; superseded lessons name what replaced them.

decisions.title: Keep every spec-pinned or test-pinned doc path; add guides beside them
decisions.rationale: docs/skills-workflow.md, docs/guides/workflow.md, and docs/cloud-deployment.md keep paths and pinned content; renaming would cost three spec deltas, a test rewrite, and 17 referrer edits for no reader-visible gain.

decisions.title: Document metadata as YAML frontmatter for Layer 1 and an HTML doc-meta comment for Layer 0
decisions.rationale: GitHub renders frontmatter as a table; that is noise above README and costs tokens in CLAUDE.md. Data ships now, the claim checker is Phase B.

decisions.title: Hand-authored restructure over producer-backed blocks (Gate 1)
decisions.rationale: Avoids a producer version bump, a CI OUTPUT_PATHS edit, and a project-context-refresh delta; keeps this change decoupled from gate-drift-with-mirrors-hooks-and-blocking-ci.

next_steps: Run /vision to produce VISION.md, then /implement-feature restructure-documentation-layers.
wp-tests first (RED), then wp-entry-and-map, wp-guides, wp-lessons in parallel, then wp-integration.
